# scc_device_tenant_policy (Resource)

Manages the DeviceTenantPolicy object via New-DeviceTenantPolicy / Get-DeviceTenantPolicy / Set-DeviceTenantPolicy / Remove-DeviceTenantPolicy.

- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `retry_distribution` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetryDistribution parameter.
